scorecard.analysis_type: Class-Separated Distribution Drift & Covariate Shift Scorecard (Remediation & Audit)

methodology.psi_bins: 10 quantile bins derived from reference training partition; exact [-inf, 0.5, inf] categorical bins for binary features
methodology.ks_test: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test (scipy.stats.ks_2samp) with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across m=36 tests
methodology.discrete_binary_tests: Two-sample pooled z-tests with survival function and Fisher's exact test
methodology.wasserstein_metric: First Wasserstein distance (unnormalized and scale-normalized by reference std)
methodology.domain_cluster_bootstrap: 2,000-iteration cluster bootstrap conditional on training reference (seed 42)

observational_diagnostics.legitimate_partition_shift: Empirical quantification reveals severe covariate shift across legitimate web URLs: 11 of 18 features exhibit severe PSI (>= 0.25), led by SpacialCharRatioInURL (PSI = 6.79), NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (PSI = 4.97), NoOfSubDomain (PSI = 2.28), NoOfEqualsInURL (PSI = 2.04), NoOfQMarkInURL (PSI = 1.99), URLLength (PSI = 1.34), and DomainLength (PSI = 1.24). Under scale-normalized Wasserstein distance, query features display extreme divergence: NoOfQMarkInURL (norm W1 = 12.07), NoOfEqualsInURL (norm W1 = 8.90), NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (norm W1 = 4.84). This empirical disparity aligns directly with the structural composition of the PhiUSIIL benign training data (where 100% lacked query parameters and mean special characters = 1.25) versus live authentic operational routes that routinely possess query strings (30.4%) and multi-level path hierarchies (mean special characters = 3.82). The data establishes significant distribution divergence; causal attribution to synthetic augmentation or specific features requires controlled counterfactual intervention.
observational_diagnostics.phishing_partition_shift: In contrast to the legitimate partition, phishing URLs exhibit substantially milder covariate drift: mean PSI is 0.1877 (vs 1.3280 for legitimate). Only 5 features show severe PSI in phishing, primarily IsHTTPS (PSI = 0.33, reflecting external phishing having 79.1% TLS adoption vs 52.2% in historical training), NoOfSubDomain (PSI = 0.79), TLDLength (PSI = 0.46), and NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (PSI = 0.57). Query parameters in phishing (NoOfEqualsInURL PSI = 0.06, NoOfQMarkInURL PSI = 0.02) show negligible drift because phishing URLs in both environments consistently utilized query strings.
observational_diagnostics.asymmetric_drift_implication: The observed covariate shift is highly asymmetric: legitimate URL structures diverged dramatically from the training baseline (mean D_KS = 0.306, mean PSI = 1.328), while phishing URL structures remained comparatively stable (mean D_KS = 0.134, mean PSI = 0.188). This asymmetric shift is consistent with the ensemble's high false-positive rate on benign URLs.
observational_diagnostics.linkage_to_historical_fpr: In Milestone 5.1, production control E0 exhibited a 94.15% false-positive rate (612/650) and candidate E4 exhibited a 92.62% false-positive rate (602/650) on the qualified external benchmark at threshold T=0.75. Stage 1 tree-path analysis proved that decision splits in both ensembles rely heavily on special characters, length, and query markers. Because benign training instances entirely lacked query markers and possessed low special-character ratios, authentic benign operational URLs bearing query parameters and complex routes map into feature regions assigned high phishing probabilities by the learned decision trees.

audit_finding_a_integrity.reference_ground_truth_justification: The frozen production model E0 and experimental candidate E4 were trained and evaluated on the authoritative feature columns of train.csv. The tree decision paths and split thresholds were learned directly from these numerical columns. Utilizing the precomputed training feature columns as the reference distribution is mathematically required to reflect the true learned decision geometry.

legitimate_verification.provenance_note: Direct socket-level retrieval confirms live reachability and valid SSL/TLS certificates: 555 TLSv1.3 (85.4%) and 95 TLSv1.2 (14.6%); 626 HTTP 200 (96.3%), 19 redirects (3.1%). Network connectivity establishes live operational status, not human-curated ground truth.

phishing_verification.provenance_note: 100% matched against upstream PhishTank verified-online threat intelligence snapshot (SHA-256 locked). All 650 records confirm verification_status='yes' and online_status='yes'. Socket TLS and HTTP responses were not recorded for malicious targets and are explicitly reported as unavailable.

audit_finding_c_domain_clustering.methodology: Independent Public Suffix List (PSL) snapshot extraction with 2,000-iteration cluster bootstrap

psl_specification.extraction_policy: Independent eTLD+1 resolution from raw URL strings

training_reference_variance_comparison.statistical_justification: Because N_train (94,523) is ~145x larger than N_ext (650), training reference sampling variance contributes negligibly (std=0.02 vs external std=0.75). External cluster uncertainty dominates total estimator variance by >35x in standard deviation (>1,200x in variance).

hypothesis_family_definition.description: 18 legitimate features + 18 phishing features evaluated for covariate shift against training baseline.
hypothesis_family_definition.multiple_testing_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) False Discovery Rate (FDR) control at alpha = 0.05
hypothesis_family_definition.zero_underflow_prevention: p-values below IEEE-754 double float underflow are serialized as 1e-300 rather than 0.0

continuous_ks_limitation_and_discrete_ex.binary_features: Evaluated via Fisher's exact test and two-sample proportion z-test using survival function stats.norm.sf
continuous_ks_limitation_and_discrete_ex.discrete_count_features: Evaluated via tie-corrected Mann-Whitney U test (scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu)

NoOfAmpersandInURL.discrepancy_explanation: For zero-inflated continuous and count features (e.g. NoOfDegitsInURL, DegitRatioInURL, NoOfAmpersandInURL), standard quantile binning collapses bins into identical values due to >90% identical zero values. The authoritative compute_psi implementation uses tail-separated quantiles on positive values to preserve tail resolution, yielding stable, reproducible PSI estimates across all scorecards.

audit_finding_e_psi_sensitivity.stability_conclusion: Empirical stability certified: All top drifting legitimate features (SpacialCharRatioInURL, NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL, NoOfSubDomain, NoOfEqualsInURL, NoOfQMarkInURL, URLLength, DomainLength) consistently maintain SEVERE_SHIFT (PSI >= 0.25) across all bin counts (5, 10, 20) and all smoothing levels (0.000769 to 0.01). Feature rankings are invariant to bin granularity.
